## Hi there 👋

I'm a second-year BEng Computer Science student at Anglia Ruskin University in Cambridge. I enjoy building things to understand them better, and I'm currently focused on learning how computers work at a lower level, particularly through systems programming, computer architecture, and embedded computing.


## On the workbench 🔧

Here are a few projects I’m currently working on and what I’m aiming to build.

<table>
  <tr>
    <td>
      <ul>
        <li><a href="https://github.com/george-cliff/murmur"><strong>Murmur:</strong></a> Developing an offline bird-call monitoring system for resource-constrained embedded devices in remote areas. Building a two-stage detection and species-identification pipeline in Python and Rust using lightweight machine-learning models and on-device processing.</li>
        <li><a href="https://github.com/george-cliff/triarch-compute-sim"><strong>Triarch:</strong></a> Experimenting with computer system emulation in C, C++, and Rust. Verifying the emulators against a SystemVerilog model, and evaluating performance with a Python harness to understand the trade-offs between the languages.</li>
        <li><a href="https://github.com/george-cliff/atlas-homelab"><strong>Atlas:</strong></a> A Debian home server built from salvaged PC parts, running self-hosted services including Nextcloud, Immich, and a private Git server. Using Tailscale for secure remote access, and maintaining encrypted off-site backups.</li>
      </ul>

## Contact me 📬

I’m excited to put what I’ve been learning into practice through an internship. [My CV](https://georgecliff.com/files/george-cliff-cv.pdf) covers my experience so far, and I’ll soon be sharing deeper dives into my projects on [my website](https://georgecliff.com). I’m always happy to chat!
